name: Constant Contact
description: Go from email idea to a polished, ready-to-send campaign with the Constant Contact app. Describe the email you want, and the Constant Contact app will generate the HTML and render a live preview. Not quite right? Give feedback in chat, make edits, and preview again until it's exactly what you want. When you're ready to send, connect or create a Constant Contact account to import your email and reach your audience.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Constant Contact to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Constant Contact to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.apps.constantcontact.com/public_api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Constant Contact MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Constant Contact lists 14 MCP tools, including check_campaign_schedule_readiness, get_campaign_html_preview, public_render_subject_line_score, getPhysicalAddress, putPhysicalAddress, addPhysicalAddress, retrieveEmailAddresses, addAccountEmailAddress, createList, putList, bulkImportContactsJSON, and createEmailCampaignUsingPOST.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Constant Contact?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Constant Contact in marketing-seo on the Manufact MCP catalog include Buzzfy, Airefs AI Visibility, TalkGenAI, RankControl, and attentive-mcp-server.

_published_faq.name: Does Constant Contact MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Constant Contact requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Constant Contact is developed by Constant Contact. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
